title: Addition and Subtraction
objectives: Perform addition and subtraction with multi-digit numbers
Apply addition and subtraction to solve word problems
Recognize the relationship between addition and subtraction

introduction.context: Addition and subtraction are fundamental operations used daily - from calculating change at the store to measuring ingredients in cooking. Mastering these operations with regrouping is essential for all future math.
introduction.connection: This chapter builds on your understanding of place value from Chapter 1, using that knowledge to perform calculations with larger numbers.

concepts.title: Addition with Regrouping
concepts.content: When adding numbers, sometimes the sum in a column exceeds 9. We 'carry over' the extra value to the next column. This is called regrouping or carrying.

concepts.title: Subtraction with Regrouping
concepts.content: When subtracting, if the top digit is smaller than the bottom digit, we 'borrow' from the next column. This is regrouping in subtraction.

commonErrors: Forgetting to carry the regrouped amount
Adding the carried amount to the wrong column

hints: Remember to carry when the sum is greater than 9
Then add the tens place including any carried amount
Don't forget to carry when needed
Work column by column from right to left
